_comment: Copy to data/screening-answers.json (gitignored) and fill in. Used verbatim for screening questions. Anything left as TODO blocks auto-apply until filled; set a value to "" to have it ignored.
work_authorization_us: TODO: start with Yes or No, e.g. Yes, authorized to work in the US; no sponsorship required now or in the future.
requires_sponsorship: TODO: Yes / No (start with the word, the form filler keys off it)
us_citizen: TODO: Yes / No (many defense and aerospace roles require US citizenship)
security_clearance: TODO: e.g. None, but eligible to obtain
earliest_start_date: TODO: e.g. May 2027 for summer internships
internship_term: TODO: e.g. Summer 2027; also open to Fall 2027 co-op
graduation_date: TODO: e.g. May 2028, B.S. Computer Science
willing_to_relocate: Yes, open to relocating anywhere in the US.
remote_preference: Prefer in-person or hybrid, especially for hardware and robotics work.
compensation_expectations: Open; happy to discuss market rate for the role.
veteran_status: I am not a protected veteran
